title: Codex Predicts Your NEXT Prompt? The Important Catch! #shorts
description:
Codex Composer predictions entered beta on October 9, 2026. In eligible Codex desktop sessions it can suggest a next instruction; pressing Tab accepts the suggestion into the composer but DOES NOT send it. This is a beta for eligible adult personal ChatGPT Pro users in supported regions with compatible models and local/SSH threads. It is NOT available in regular ChatGPT chat.

Visuals are ORIGINAL ILLUSTRATIVE RECONSTRUCTIONS, NOT screenshots or a live Codex test.

Official notes: https://openai.com/products/release-notes/
